name: sonner
useFor: Mount Toaster once near the root and call toast() from sonner anywhere: toast("Sandbox paused", { description, action }), toast.success, toast.error, toast.warning, toast.info and toast.promise for work in flight. Keep titles short and say what happened; give an undo action where one exists.
constraints: A toast for something people must act on (use a dialog)
source: Extrapolated from the Hoplite website's popups (the nav sheet and menus, .hn__): the square ground panel with its hairline and long cast, and its compact keys (.button--s)
title: Sonner
description: Toasts: square panels of the ground with the floating shadow, a 16px status glyph, a 14px medium title over a quiet description, a compact ink hexagon action and a ghost close glyph. Stacked at the bottom right; they rise in 240ms and leave in 200ms. A long description scrolls and fades at the edge it scrolls past (fade-y).
